title: Knife through paste
brief: The opening shot. Low, from the side, so the ridges catch the light. One slow, confident drag of thick paste. Keep the real scrape sound, no talking.

title: The tubes
brief: Paint tubes on the table, a few picked up and put down. Behind the words: Which colors do I mix?

title: Scraped-out pot
brief: A mix almost gone, knife scraping the last of it, a band half done. Behind the words: How much paint will it take?

title: Canvas: bands marked
brief: Photo or clip of the canvas with the pencil lines on it. Same camera position for all three stages.

title: Canvas: paste laid
brief: The canvas with the white paste on, before any color. Side light so the ridges show.

title: Canvas: color going on
brief: The canvas part-painted, with the same bands done as the plan picture beside it.

title: Taking the bowl photo
brief: Paint being mixed in the bowl, then a phone taking a picture of it, with a white rag or paper in the shot.

title: Screen recording: whole-canvas check-in
brief: Record on the live site. Check-ins, Whole canvas, upload a real photo of THIS canvas, show coverage and each band's color. This one makes a SAM call, so it isn't recorded for you.

title: Time-lapse of the painting
brief: Fixed camera, whole canvas, across the days. Any length: it gets sped up to fit. Your cinematic moment, there's no voiceover over it.

title: Your wife, in her own words
brief: One honest sentence about using it, on camera or at the canvas. Unscripted. Whatever she actually thinks.

title: THE SHOT: the painting on that wall
brief: The finished canvas on the wall, from exactly where the wall photo was taken: cabinet on the left, doorway on the right. Hold still. The app's mockup dissolves into this.

title: Close on the finished ridges
brief: Slow push or pan across the finished surface, side light.
